title: mcp-ssh configuration
description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for the mcp-ssh configuration file. This schema mirrors the strict validation performed by ``ConfigManager._validate`` in lib/config.py. Note: a few runtime-only constraints cannot be fully expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced at load time (e.g. regex validity of block_patterns, CIDR overlap between networks, and rule targets referencing an existing ssh_target).

version.description: Config schema version. Only version 1 is currently supported.

ssh_targets.description: Map of SSH target identifiers to their connection settings. Must be non-empty. Count is enforced at load time (see MAX_TARGETS).

block_patterns.description: Regular expressions that deny a command if matched. Each entry must be a valid regex and must not contain ReDoS-prone constructs such as nested quantifiers (validity and ReDoS risk are enforced at load time). Count and pattern length are enforced at load time.

allowed_commands.description: Layered command authorization rules: default rules for all clients, plus per-API-key and per-network rules.

default.description: Rules applied to every client. Must be a non-empty list.

api_keys.description: Per-API-key rules. Empty list is allowed.

networks.description: Per-source-CIDR rules. Empty list is allowed; overlapping ranges are rejected at load time.

sshTarget.description: Connection settings for a single SSH target. At least one of private_key or password must be provided (enforced at load time).

port.description: TCP port. Defaults to 22 when omitted.

checkcommand.description: Command executed to verify SSH connectivity

rule.description: A command-allowance rule: a list of targets and the commands permitted on them.

apiKey.description: A named API key with its own set of command rules. key_hash must be 'sha256:<64 hex>' or 'pbkdf2:sha256:<iter>$<salt>$<64 hex>'.

network.description: A source CIDR range with its own set of command rules.

range.description: IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR (e.g. '10.0.0.0/8'). Validity is enforced at load time.

settings.description: Runtime settings. All keys are optional; unspecified keys fall back to bundled defaults.

max_output_length.description: Maximum length of command output returned to LLMs. An integer byte count or a size string (b/kb/mb/gb, case-insensitive, e.g. '50kb').

command_timeout_max.description: Maximum timeout (seconds) for remote command execution.

retry_max_attempts.description: Maximum number of SSH connection attempts (including the first).

retry_backoff_base_seconds.description: Base delay (seconds) for exponential backoff between SSH retries.

circuit_breaker_failure_threshold.description: Consecutive per-target failures before the circuit opens.

circuit_breaker_timeout_seconds.description: Time (seconds) an open circuit waits before allowing a half-open probe.

log_level.description: Logging level. One of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

max_log_output.description: Maximum number of output characters stored in a log entry.

compress_rotated.description: Whether rotated log files are gzip-compressed.

pool_max_connections_per_target.description: Maximum number of idle connections kept per SSH target.

pool_idle_timeout_seconds.description: Time (seconds) an idle pooled connection is kept before eviction.

pool_cleanup_interval_seconds.description: Interval (seconds) between idle-cleanup sweeps of the pool.

max_concurrent_ssh_connections.description: Global maximum number of concurrently checked-out SSH connections across all targets. Excess acquisitions are rejected with an HTTP 503 Service Unavailable response rather than queued.

watcher_debounce_seconds.description: Minimum delay (seconds) between config reloads on file change. 0 disables debouncing.

trusted_proxies.description: Optional list of trusted reverse-proxy IP addresses. When non-empty, the X-Forwarded-For header is only honored when the direct connection peer is in this list. An empty list (default) means no proxy is trusted and the header is ignored entirely. Entries must be valid IP addresses (IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4-mapped IPv6).

sandbox_root.description: Root directory that constrains all SFTP paths via realpath. '/' means unrestricted.

max_path_length.description: Maximum allowed length (bytes) for SFTP remote paths. 0 disables the check.
